data.name: Bhagwan
data.gender_notes: Bhagwan is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit bhaga, 'fortune, lord', + the possessive suffix — 'the blessed one, God'. Its root is Sanskrit bhaga + vat. A common Sanskrit term for God. Bhagwan is a Sanskrit name meaning “God; the blessed one; lord”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bhagwan expresses “God; the blessed one; lord”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit bhaga, 'fortune, lord', + the possessive suffix — 'the blessed one, God'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhagwan total 29, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.
